9:     size_t tail;            /* next write position (newest byte) */
10:     size_t capacity;        /* usable storage length */
11:     unsigned int magic;
12: };

14: ringbuf_t *rb_create(size_t capacity) {
15:     if (capacity == 0)

17:     ringbuf_t *rb = malloc(sizeof(*rb));
18:     if (!rb)
19:         return NULL;
20:     rb->buf = calloc(capacity, sizeof(uint8_t));
21:     if (!rb->buf) {
22:         free(rb);

25:     rb->head = 0;
